name: Cognitive Maze v1.2.6 - Universal Standalone Asset Loading & Installer Polish
notes: Version 1.2.6 — Fix: Resolved critical asset-resolution failure on newly installed PCs where PyInstaller onedir modules in _internal evaluated directory levels above application root, causing game tiles, character sprites, and map portals to fall back to solid colored boxes; updated Inno Setup shortcuts to strictly set WorkingDir to the installation directory and granted full user permissions for db/saves and db/cache so school lab student accounts can save progress without admin privileges. Changes: Introduced core.paths universal path resolver supporting frozen binaries and development workspaces; redundant dual-sync build pipeline ensuring assets exist in both root and _internal directories; automated frozen build validation test suite.
